sentences.text:
Biswajit Paladhi @ Biswajit Paladi vs Unknown on 5 March, 2026
05.03.2026
Item No.42
Ct. No. 34
 nb
 Crr 4733 of 2025

In the matter of: Biswajit Paladhi @ Biswajit Paladi
 ...... Petitioner.
 Mr. Navanil De
 Mr. Subhrajit Dey
 Ms. Monami Mukherjee
 ....

For the Petitioner
 1.
This revisional application has been filed against the order dated August 6, 2025 passed by the
Additional
District & Sessions Judge, 3 rd Court.

Tamluk, Purba Midnapore, wherein the learned Trial Court took cognizance of the Supplementary Charge Sheet dated June 13, 2025 impleading the brother-in-law as an accused under Sections 498A/354/307/34 of the IPC.
2.

It is submitted on behalf of the petitioner that on completion of the investigation in respect of the complaint lodged by the opposite party no.2, the charge-sheet was filed so far as the present petitioner being the accused brother-in-law was concerned, an application filed for re-investigation.
The learned Court refused to entertain the same.
The matter went to trial.

In course of evidence suddenly on the prayer made by the prosecution, the I.O. was show-caused for not impleading the present petitioner as party and then, the I.O. submitted the charge-sheet on the ground that he mistakenly omitted the name of the present petitioner in the charge-sheet.
3. It is specifically argued that in the charge-sheet itself categorically, it was mentioned that in absence of any material against him, the charge-sheet could not be submitted.
Therefore, an arguable case has been made out by the petitioner and required for hearing.

4. Learned counsel, on intimation, come up before this Court to appear on behalf of the opposite party no.2.
5.

Hence, the petitioner is directed to serve copy of this revisinal application to the opposite party/State in the office of the learned Public Prosecutor, High Court, Calcutta and file affidavit of service on the next date fixed for hearing.
6. Learned advocate for the petitioner is further directed to hand over copy of this revisional application to the learned counsel, who undertakes to file Vakalatnama by tomorrow.
